newsitem.title: UK: JKX Oil in Black Sea deal with ARCO.
newsitem.headline: JKX Oil in Black Sea deal with ARCO.

text.p: British exploration group JKX Oil & Gas Plc said on Wednesday it agreed to a deal that will allow Atlantic Richfield Co (ARCO) to farm into its interest in the Georgian sector of the Black Sea.
JKX said the interest comprised 23,000 square kilometres licensed under a production sharing contract between it and the State of Georgia.

Under the "heads of agreement" deal, ARCO would earn up to 90 percent of JKX's interest in the contract in exchange for completing a staged work programme involving seismic acquisition and an exploration well.
JKX said the deal, its first partnership with a major oil company, would allow it to develop its interest in the area.
